sentences.l2: 它不会掉下来，因为有升力。
sentences.l1: It does not fall down, because there is lift.

sentences.l2: 升力是让飞机向上的力量。
sentences.l1: Lift is the force that makes an airplane go up.

sentences.l2: 当飞机跑得很快时，空气从翅膀上下流过。
sentences.l1: When an airplane runs very fast, air flows over and under the wings.

sentences.l2: 上面的空气流得快，下面的空气流得慢。
sentences.l1: The air above flows fast, and the air below flows slowly.

sentences.l2: 工程学帮助人们造飞机。
飞机飞的时候也有阻力。
sentences.l1: When an airplane flies, there is also drag.

sentences.l2: 阻力是空气挡住飞机的力量。
sentences.l1: Drag is the force of the air blocking the airplane.

sentences.l2: 发动机要用力，才能让飞机向前。
sentences.l1: The engine has to work hard in order to make the airplane go forward.

sentences.l2: 没有发动机，飞机就会慢下来。
sentences.l1: Without an engine, the airplane would slow down.

sentences.l2: 在天上，飞行员控制飞机的方向。
sentences.l1: In the sky, the pilot controls the direction of the airplane.

sentences.l2: 飞机大，人多，但只要升力够，它就能飞。
sentences.l1: The airplane is big and has many people, but as long as the lift is enough, it can fly.

sentences.l2: 我们坐飞机去远方，又快又安全。
sentences.l1: We take airplanes to faraway places, both fast and safe.
